query: SELECT id AS "id!: String" FROM record_identities INDEXED BY creation_fact_by_request WHERE kind = 'fact' AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.kind.kind') = 'lifecycle' AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.kind.fact.kind') = 'projectCreated' AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.kind.fact.creatingRequest') = ? ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
